subject: science
title: Launch a satellite
instruction: Change the satellite's height. Watch how its speed and orbit time change.
intro: You control a satellite. Change its height and watch how fast it goes round the Earth.

goals.text: Bring the satellite down to 400 km, where the International Space Station flies. How long does one trip take?
goals.say: At four hundred kilometres, one trip round the Earth takes about ninety two minutes. Low satellites move fastest.

goals.text: Navigation (GPS) satellites go round Earth twice a day, once every 12 hours. Find their height.
goals.say: About twenty thousand kilometres up, one trip takes twelve hours.

goals.text: Find the height where one trip takes one whole day. Watch the yellow dot: the satellite stays right above it!
goals.say: At about thirty six thousand kilometres the satellite turns with the Earth, so it stays above the same place. India's communication satellites sit here.
